entry.title: Respiration
entry.summary:
A slow retrospective on a season of writing, and the quiet transition now opening between fatigue, clarity, and the return to earth. Some life chapters end without a final scene.
No slammed door, no staged farewell, no single sentence that closes the book.
They finish the way dusk finishes: a slow dilution of light, almost unnoticed, until you realise the room has changed colour. This text is that kind of dusk.
It records the suspension — not the death — of a cycle I never scheduled: three months during which writing became as involuntary as breathing, and twenty essays arrived the way dreams arrive, uninvited but insistent. Today the tide has withdrawn.
